description: Test helper code for Mattermost server channels application, including setup functions, mock implementations, and test utilities.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: Helper class for setting up and managing test environment for Mattermost server channels.

classes.name: mockSuite
classes.description: Mock implementation of SuiteIFace for testing purposes.

methods.name: setupDBStore
methods.description: Initializes database store and settings for testing.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Sets up test environment with database and configuration.

methods.name: (*TestHelper) InitBasic
methods.description: Initializes basic test data including admin, users, team, and channel.

methods.name: SetupWithStoreMock
methods.description: Sets up test environment with a mocked store.

methods.name: SetupWithCluster
methods.description: Sets up test environment with a cluster interface.

methods.name: (*TestHelper) Shutdown
methods.description: Cleans up and shuts down the test environment.

methods.name: (*TestHelper) CreateTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team for testing.

methods.name: (*TestHelper) CreateUserOrGuest
methods.description: Creates a new user or guest for testing.

methods.name: (*TestHelper) CreateAdmin
methods.description: Creates an admin user for testing.

methods.name: (*TestHelper) CreateChannel
methods.description: Creates a new channel within a team for testing.
